subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Duo
solution:
The correct answer is '**Pair**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate **synonym** of the given word '**Duo**' is '**Pair**'.
 
• **Duo**: two people playing music or singing together. (एक साथ प्रदर्शन करने वाले गायकों या वादकों की जोड़ी; युगलगान, युगलवादन)
 
 
• *Example: The comedy **duo** will perform tonight.*
 
 
 
• **Pair**: two things of the same type that are used or worn together. (एक ही प्रकार की दो वस्‍तुएँ जिनको साथ-साथ प्रयोग किया या पहना जाता है; जोड़ा, युग्‍म)
 
 
• *Example: a **pair** of shoes/gloves/earrings...*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Pair.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Debt**: an amount of money that you owe to somebody. (कर्ज़, ऋण)
 
• **Loan**: money, etc. that somebody/something lends you. (उधार, ऋण)
 
• **Bond**: something that joins two or more people or groups of people together, such as a feeling of friendship. [दो व्‍यक्तियों या जनसमूहों को बाँधने या जोड़ने वाली शक्ति, भावना आदि (जैसे मैत्री या बंधुत्‍व); बंधन, संबंध]
